what: Every call of `/root/loop.sh` by any lane kills the daemon of `/root/inst/blaze-engine` and replaces `/root/inst/blaze`, and checks another branch out in `/root/blaze`, so a run longer than one call (a `blaze test -p blaze-std` of three minutes started as a systemd unit) cannot use `/root/inst` or `/root/blaze`.
cost: twenty minutes writing a wrapper (prep.sh) before the first run
cause: one install directory and one checkout for every lane
workaround: inside my loop call: copy `/root/inst/blaze{,-engine}` to `/root/inst-bstd/`, `git worktree add --detach /root/wt/<branch>`, and start the unit on those
fix: loop.sh installs to `/root/inst/<branch>/` and keeps `/root/wt/<branch>` at the tip itself, and takes `--unit <name>` to start the command as a systemd unit and print how to poll it
